# webtables/shr

> Arithmetic shift right: `>>`, the count taken modulo 64, with `i64.shr_s`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/shr.pkg) · translates [std/shr](../std/shr.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.shr_s
{left}
{right}
)
```
